findings.title: An id lookup shadows a task whose title looks like an id
findings.why: `find` checks `tasks.get(key)` before it looks up the title. After adding "Sweep" (id `task-1`) and then a task titled "task-1", `complete`, `remove` and `rename` with "task-1" act on "Sweep". The second task cannot be reached by its title. `add` and `rename` do not reject titles that match an existing id.

findings.title: A rejected duplicate add still uses up an id
findings.why: `issued += 1` runs before the duplicate-title check, so a rejected add leaves a gap in the id sequence.
